render_scale.doc: Azahar at 2x (800x480 top screen) runs most games on the Deck; 3x is past its GPU in the heavy ones.

doc.intent: On Linux the n3ds system launches through RetroArch's Azahar libretro core by default (top/bottom layout, hardware shaders), with RetroArch's Citra core and the standalone Azahar build as alternates; standalone Azahar is the only macOS route. Semu owns the dual-screen presentation contract: the core stacks the 400x240 top and 320x240 bottom screens into one frame and the renderer partitions it by the declared native sizes.
doc.core: The default core is Semu's own build of the Azahar tree's libretro target (config/emulators/retroarch/cores/azahar); its options keep the citra_ prefix upstream.

titles.doc: The NCSD media id (0x108, 8 bytes little-endian) is the title id Azahar files load/mods and load/textures under (<016X>); od -t x8 -j 264 -N 8 on the owner's Ocarina of Time 3D (Europe) gives 0004000000033600. Encrypted dumps keep this header in the clear.
